newsitem.title: CHILE: Coca Cola in Chile bottler talks - report.
newsitem.headline: Coca Cola in Chile bottler talks - report.

text.p: A group of investors including The Coca Cola Company is in talks to buy five percent of Chilean bottler Embotelladora Andina for around $100 million, the El Diario reported Wednesday.
Companies linked to Coca Cola bought a seven percent stake in Andina last year for $140 million with the funds used to finance the firm's expansion abroad.
A statement filed at the SEC said Coca Cola was in talks to buy 18 million shares at $5.45 each, according to the newspaper.
Andina declined to comment on the report.
